notes: Customer: Meridian Crest Solutions — mid-market analytics SaaS focused on in-app product help and knowledge search.
Primary drivers: lower per-token unit cost and predictable latency for in-app chat (support) and doc search during peak usage.
Started with Hosted API to validate model quality and token footprint. Trial produced useful telemetry: see POC metrics doc.

Trial summary (observed over 2 weeks): avg QPS (baseline): 3.8 qps; peak QPS observed 16 qps during Tuesday product release; avg concurrency (active requests): 6; p50 latency (first byte): 180ms; p95 latency: 620ms; average request token input: 420 tokens; average response tokens: 610 tokens; token mix: 45% short replies (<200 tokens) mainly quick search, 35% medium (200-800), 20% long (800-2000) — long tail driven by deep summarization & multi-doc synth.

Cost sensitivity: finance flagged token spend after trial — wants predictability and committed discounts. Looking for model routing to cheaper variants for lower-quality fallback (e.g., distilled models) during peaks.
Security: must support SSO/SAML for console, KMS for key control, and 1 year audit log retention. Data residency preference: US but ok with multi-region fallbacks behind VPC.

Dedicated sizing notes from SE (Liam): based on token mix & observed QPS, recommended starting Dedicated cluster = 4 x 80GB GPUs (serving MPT-like family quantized run) with autoscale to 6 GPUs for 2x peak headroom. Expected steady-state concurrency per GPU ~ 12 concurrent users for their median sequence lengths. This maps to target baseline throughput ~12k tokens/sec aggregate (rough calc: concurrency * tokens-per-request / avg response time).

Quick budget estimate (SE rough): committed cluster (4 GPUs) + infra and SW ~ $65k/month; with 20% reserved discount ARR estimate lands in '50k-250k' band depending on contract length and usage credits.

Next technical asks from engineering: precise concurrency/latency SLOs per route, ability to route long summaries to specialized instance types, KV cache sizing for prefix reuse, and per-route token attribution in console (to identify expensive prompts).
Notes from CTO (call): 'If Redwood can demonstrate 30% cost reduction vs hosted pay-as-you-go at our forecasted QPS, we'll move to Dedicated Q1.'
POC artifacts: see drive links — includes raw telemetry (qps/concurrency/token histograms), trial billing dump, and SE sizing workbook.
